title: 5 Simple Checks Before the First Frost
caption: As summer fades and Saskatoon’s cooler days approach, a few quick vehicle checks can save you from surprises on the road. Inspect your battery terminals for corrosion, top off antifreeze, check tire pressure, replace worn wiper blades, and make sure all lights are working. These steps help keep your car reliable when the temperature drops.
image_prompt: A mechanic in a Saskatoon garage inspecting a car battery, with autumn leaves and a crisp sky in the background.

title: When You Forget to Start Your Car in -20°C
caption: It’s that classic Saskatoon moment: you step outside, realize you never started the car, and now you’re dealing with a frozen windshield. At least we can get you moving again quickly—no meme-worthy waiting required!

title: Why Proper Tire Pressure Matters on Saskatoon Roads
caption: Under‑inflated tires reduce traction on icy or snow‑covered streets, increase stopping distances, and can lead to uneven wear that shortens tire life. Check pressure monthly and before long trips, and remember that Saskatoon’s temperature swings can cause pressure to drop by a few PSI overnight.
